title: Harborline SiteGuard Tier Changes: Upgrade Proration, Downgrades and Auto-Renew Switching
content:
**Rule.** A change to a Website Security plan's tier may be made only while the plan status is active. An upgrade to one of the tiers the current tier may move up to mid-term takes effect at once and is billed as the target's term price minus the current tier's term price for the current term length, after the discount basis of Website Security pricing, times the calendar days from today to the term end over the calendar days of the term, rounded half up to the cent. A move down takes effect only at the next renewal, and auto-renew may be switched at any time while the plan is active or cancel pending.

## Quantities in the upgrade amount

- **Price difference**: the target tier's term price minus the current tier's term price, both for the plan's current term length (12-month or 1-month), after the discount basis of Website Security pricing — the higher of the hosted-site discount percentage for a site on an active Harborline hosting plan and the website security discount percentage of the customer's account tier, the two never added.
- **Remaining days**: the calendar days from today, the day of the upgrade, to the term end date.
- **Term days**: the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date.

The upgrade amount is the price difference multiplied by the remaining days, divided by the term days, and rounded half up to the cent. It is billed as one upgrade charge covering the upgrade date to the term end, and the plan's tier changes to the target tier from the upgrade date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical inputs: target tier term price 300.00, current tier term price 120.00, discount percentage 20, remaining days 50, term days 365.

1. The target's term price after the discount is 240.00 and the current tier's is 96.00; the price difference is 144.00.
2. 144.00 multiplied by 50 is 7200.00; divided by 365 it is 19.7260 and a fraction.
3. Rounded half up to the cent, the upgrade amount is 19.73.

## Which moves take effect when

| Move | Plan status | Takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| Up to a tier listed among the current tier's upgrade targets | Active | At once, billed as above |
| Down to a lower tier | Active | Only at the next renewal |
| Any tier change | Pending setup, cancel pending, expired or cancelled | Not made |
| Auto-renew switched on or off | Active or cancel pending | At any time |
